title.en: An Act Converting the Nueva Vizcaya Rural High School in the Municipality of Bayombong, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, to a National Agricultural School to be Known as the Nueva Vizcaya National Agricultural School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Nông thôn Nueva Vizcaya thành Trường Nông nghiệp Nueva Vizcaya Quốc gia tại Đô thị Bayombong, Tỉnh Nueva Vizcaya, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาชนบท Nueva Vizcaya เป็น โรงเรียนเกษตรกรรม Nueva Vizcaya แห่งชาติ ในเทศบาล Bayombong จังหวัด Nueva Vizcaya และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้

text.en: The Nueva Vizcaya Rural High School located in the Municipality of Bayombong, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, is hereby converted to a national agricultural school of secondary level, to be known as the Nueva Vizcaya National Agricultural School. The Secretary of Education is hereby empowered to reorganize said school accordingly.

The sum of one hundred and fifty thousand pesos is authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the operation and maintenance of said school for the school year nineteen hundred and fifty-five to nineteen hundred and fifty-six. The necessary funds for the purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
